title: fix(console): the named-form page sizes a field from its span, not only its colSpan
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBUGgrNWoBUQKbyS4GaX5vM)_

Fixes #37559

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/plugin-form/core` exports `resolveColSpan`, which is already public from the package root)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在具名表单页上填表的用户会看到：标为整行的字段和多行文本类字段占满一整行，不再挤在一格里。
- 不属于任何 epic；替按表单视图配置字段宽度的应用作者兑现规格里已经声明的宽度规则。
- 出错时只影响该页字段的宽度排布，不影响数据与提交，回退本次合并即可撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`: each row's width is resolved by the record form's own resolver, `resolveColSpan`, against the section's column count. Before, the row read `colSpan` alone. The precedence is the FormFieldSchema `span` contract: `span: 'full'` comes first, then an authored `colSpan` clamped to the grid, then the `span: 'auto'` wide-type default (textarea, markdown, html, richtext, and a multiple file or image field). The type goes through `mapFieldTypeToFormType` with the effective `multiple`, the same way the record form's `sectionFields.ts` does it. This page's grid has a single multi-column tier (`sm:grid-cols-N`), so one `sm:col-span-N` class is the whole row at every multi-column tier.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/core.ts`: adds `resolveColSpan` to the side-effect-free `/core` subpath (one export line), so the console can reach it without loading the form renderers. `autoLayout.ts` is already in that subpath's closure and in the `plugin-form-core` chunk group, so the bundle split does not change.
- `.changeset/37559-form-page-field-span.md`: patch for `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/plugin-form`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `FormPage.tsx`, the `colSpan:` entry in the section builder. This is where the precedence is decided.
2. `core.ts`, the export list. This is the new public name.
3. `FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx`, which pins the rendered class.

## Tests

New file `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx` drives the real `/forms/:name` route and reads the rendered `sm:col-span-N` class on each row:
- a `span: 'full'` field and a textarea each take 2 cells in a 2-column section;
- the same two take 3 cells in a 3-column section;
- CONTROL: a plain text field stays one cell;
- CONTROL: an authored `colSpan` wins, so a textarea with `colSpan: 1` stays one cell and `colSpan: 2` renders 2 cells in a 4-column section.

<details><summary>Pins and ablation readings (head c2192006fe)</summary>

- `vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/components/FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx FormPage.maxLength.test.tsx FormPage.test.ts` (ui root, under the verify lock): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 84 passed (84).
- Ablation: the `resolveColSpan` call was replaced on disk with `colSpan: override.colSpan ?? 1` (the pre-fix line, confirmed at line 925) and the run repeated: `VERDICT command-exit 1`, 2 failed and 2 passed (4). Both span pins went red (`expected 1 to be 2`, `expected 1 to be 3`) and both CONTROLs stayed green. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and the porcelain status was empty afterwards.

</details>

<details><summary>Type-check and derived gate readings (head c2192006fe)</summary>

- I built the closure with `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='@object-ui/console^...'` (Tasks: 79 successful, 79 total). Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` both ran to completion, and the lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The console tsconfig includes `src`, so the new test file is compiled.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 38 families. All 38 ran locally with exit 0, and `--ran` reports 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero, since every row recorded its exit code).
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against origin/main 05563a57f0.
- `test:repo` and the full UI/Core batteries are left to CI.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Follow-up reading: after this lands, re-score platform-checklist `records-forms` acceptance[2] (the width half, knownGaps[2]).
- Noted, not filed: on `span: 'auto'`, a repeater resolves to one cell on both form renderers. The spec docblock on `FormFieldSchema.span` says a repeater reaches the full row through the `field:grid` widget, but `mapFieldTypeToFormType` now maps repeater to `field:object`, which is not in `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`. This was read from the code and has not been reproduced.
- Noted, not filed: the app-shell authoring type `FormFieldSpec` declares `colSpan` but not `span`, so this page reads the served entry's `span` through a cast, the same way `resolveColSpan` does.
- The declaration line above is copied verbatim from the claim amendment. One part of its parenthesis does not match the tree: `resolveColSpan` is not exported from the package root today. The root exports `applyAutoColSpan`, which calls it. So this PR makes the name public for the first time. The changeset carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)` without that parenthesis.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.fieldSpan-37559.test.tsx` from `ui/`. Expected: 4 passed. In the showcase app, open `/forms/showcase_task.form` and set Priority to Urgent. The Notes field appears (`span: 'full'`) and spans the whole row of its two-column section.
